[h2]What to Know Before Patch Installation[/h2]

[*] All new items introduced in this patch will not be required for any game achievements.
[/list]
[h2]Major Updates[/h2]

[h3]New Gameplay: Challenge[/h3]
[i]"It's tough to confront the old rivals anew, but the Great Sage will always prevail!"[/i]
[list]
[*] After completing the game at least once, the Destined One can find "Challenge" at any Keeper's Shrine.
[*] There are two types of challenge available: "Return of Rivals" and "Gauntlet of Legends".
[*] "Return of Rivals"
[list]
[*] The Destined One can challenge a former opponent to a duel, choosing from three levels of difficulty.
[*] If any opponents remain undefeated in the main game, the corresponding rebattle will be unavailable.
[/list]
[*] "Gauntlet of Legends"
[list]
[*] The Destined One can battle against multiple opponents in succession, using customized curses to tailor the difficulty.
[*] This mode can be difficult, as some old opponents may surprise with new moves. Proceed with caution!
[*] If any opponents remain undefeated in the main game, the related gauntlet will be unavailable.
[*] Completing any gauntlet rewards players with new rare treasures.
[list]
[*] Medicine: "Glimmering Scale Pellets" and its formula;
[*] Drink and Soaks: "Sour Wine", "Frost-Enduring Chrysanth", and "Robust Antler";
[*] Curios: "Stone Tiger Tally", "Ever-Burning Palace Lantern", and "Fragment of the Ocean-Settling Pillar";
[*] Equipment: "Three Hill Crown";
[*] Weapons: "Qing Mallet", "Fanged Cyan Staff", and "Leeching Centipede Staff".
[/list][/list][/list]
[h3]New Game Feature: Journeyer's Chart[/h3]
[i]"Let the chart chart the journeyer's journey."[/i]
[list]
[*] A remarkable one has captured these landscapes, organizing them into charts for guidance and marking.
[*] A Journeyer's Chart can be unlocked when the Destined One first enters Black Wind Mountain and meets the Keeper.
[*] Afterwards, for each new territory reached, a "Journeyer's Chart" can be purchased at the Keeper's Shrine.
[/list]
[h3]New Equipment: Armor Set of Opulence[/h3]
[i]As the year comes to a close, we wish all Destined Ones an early Happy Chinese New Year! May you have joy and prosperity all year round.[/i]
[list]
[*] Four special armor pieces have been crafted to celebrate the upcoming Chinese New Year.
[*] After installation, all Destined Ones can claim these directly through "Trailblazer's Gift" at any Keeper's Shrine.
[/list]
[h3]New Music Library Functions[/h3]

notes.title: Black Myth Wukong guide and walkthrough
notes.notes:
Looking for a Black Myth Wukong guide and walkthrough? The classic 16th-century Chinese novel, Journey to the West, has been a major influence for videogames since their inception, and developer Game Science's soulslike is the latest of the bunch. Black Myth Wukong's protagonist is on a quest that takes him through a similar gauntlet of trials as Journey to the West's Sun Wukong, and this trickster warrior has plenty of abilities up his sleeve.

We consider Black Myth Wukong a surprise GOTY contender for 2024; our Black Myth Wukong review calls it "an ambitious action RPG with stunning visuals, colossal boss designs, and snappy combat." It's also fiendishly challenging at times. Thankfully, we've got Black Myth Wukong guides and walkthroughs for just about anything you need in the action-adventure game, whether that's boss strategies, the best gear, and even the system requirements required to run it.
